review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The AWS Region Services team combines AWS global cloud leadership with Australian security expertise to deliver highly secure, scalable environments for sensitive workloads. You sketch the architecture, validate it against security requirements, and begin translating your design into automated deployment scripts. We provide 'hands on keyboard' support to our service teams by deploying changes into these isolated regions, monitoring the results, and reporting any issues that are observed. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
